deadline.value: Official pages disagree. Department page: February 1 for Fall (September) entry, with only domestic applicants considered after the deadline (Feb 1 also needed for award consideration). PhD program page: international Fall deadline May 1 (domestic August 31). Coded the earlier date; department recommends internationals apply 9+ months before the start term. Year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall (September) | February 1st | For Domestic students (Canadians and Permanent Residents) applications will be considered after these deadlines, although this may impact your eligibility for major awards and scholarships in your first year.

also.quote: The application deadline is August 31 (domestic) and May 1 (international) for Fall

app_fee.quote: The application fee for most graduate programs is $125. | Please note: This fee is non refundable and is payable to OUAC.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_physics.value: Physics GRE required for applicants whose degrees are not from a Canadian institution (minimum 800); an application below a minimum is still considered as a whole
gre_physics.quote: For applicants whose previous/current degree(s) are NOT from a Canadian institution | Physics SUBJECT Graduate Record Exam (GRE) with a minimum score of 800 | If you are applying from an institution outside of Canada we require a Physics Subject GRE.

also.quote: GRE Physics Subject Test score for all applicants who have completed their post-secondary education outside of Canada.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 89 with no section below 21 (tests before Jan 21, 2026); 4.5 overall and 4.0 per section on the new scale; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 120
toefl_min.quote: For tests prior January 21, 2026, a minimum overall score of 89 must be achieved with no categories below 21. | A minimum score of 4.0 must be achieved in each of the four categories (listening, speaking, reading, writing).

english_waiver.value: If your prior post-secondary study was taught in English you may request a waiver, decided case by case by the department; physics also asks for a test if your English-medium degree was completed more than two years ago
english_waiver.quote: If your first language is not English but you have completed prior post-secondary studies in which English was the language instruction, you may request to have your English Language Proficiency requirement waived. These decisions are made on a case-by-case basis by the department you are applying to.

also.quote: You must provide an English Language Proficiency (ELP) test if; English is not your first language, your BSc or MSc was completed in English more than two years ago or your previous education was not completed in English.

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor before applying (list 2-3 potential supervisors), but approved applicants are admitted only if a supervisor match is found
supervisor.quote: Students DO NOT need to find a supervisor prior to applying. | Approved applicants are admitted to either of these research programs ONLY if a supervisor match is found.

funding.value: Full funding typically provided to full-time thesis-based students without external funding (scholarships, TA, RA); no minimum amount stated
funding.quote: Full funding is typically provided for full-time, thesis-based students (who do not receive external funding) through a combination of scholarships, teaching assistantships, and/or research assistantships.

entry_route.value: An MSc in physics (75%+) is normally required; exceptional BSc holders may be considered for direct PhD entry, but most BSc applicants receive MSc offers; MSc-to-PhD transfer possible
entry_route.quote: an MSc degree in Physics is normally required for entrance into the PhD program. | Exceptional students may be considered for accelerated MSc or direct entry to PhD programs, but the majority of applicants holding a BSc degree will be made offers into the MSc program.

notes: Physics PhD run jointly with Waterloo through the Guelph-Waterloo Physics Institute (shared courses). Applications go through OUAC.
